name: opencode
args:
set -u
command -v opencode >/dev/null || { echo "opencode isn't on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
OPENCODE_PASSWORD=$(od -An -N24 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')
export OPENCODE_PASSWORD
server=http://127.0.0.1:{port}
serve_log=$(mktemp)
opencode serve --port {port} >"$serve_log" 2>&1 &
serve_pid=$!
trap 'kill $serve_pid 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$serve_log"' EXIT
mcp() { curl -sS -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_PASSWORD" "$server/api/mcp" 2>&1; }
tries=0
until mcp | grep -q '"name":"legion","status":{"status":"connected"'; do
  if ! kill -0 "$serve_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "opencode serve stopped: $(tail -n 5 "$serve_log" | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  if [ "$tries" -gt 120 ]; then
    echo "Legion's tools didn't connect to OpenCode in 60 seconds: $(mcp)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
opencode mini --server "$server" --model "$2" --agent legion --prompt "$1"
